evidence.exact_span: It is readily apparent that contentious protection visa applications might never be resolved in circumstances where country information of the kind traditionally or usually considered at Tribunal hearings was required to be updated in the course of subsequent proceedings pursued beyond the culmination of such Tribunal proceedings, except perhaps upon the basis of sufficiently cogent evidence of significant change being first foreshadowed on a cognisable basis by the initially unsuccessful applicant for review. No such evidence was provided, much less with any compelling particularity.
